ns2:course.label: Bioprocessing Biomass for Fuel
ns2:course.description: Engineering and scientific principles governing bioprocessing of biomass for production of ethanol and other fermentation products. Process unit operations; conventional and alternative feed stock materials; recovery of value-added coproducts and other variables involved in producing fuel ethanol; process simulation; economic analysis. Prerequisite: CHBE 321 and TAM 335.
